title: jai.toml
description: Project settings for jailsp: the files it builds and where its modules are. https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/compiler/language-server.md#project-settings-jaitoml

build_files.markdownDescription: The files you give `jaic build` (or `add_build_file`), relative to this file, such as `["first.jai"]` or `["src/main.jai"]`. Default: those of `build.jai`, `first.jai`, `main.jai` and `src/main.jai` that exist.

import_path.markdownDescription: More folders to import modules from, relative to this file, as `-import_dir` adds (`Build_Options.import_path`). The `modules` folder next to the build file is always searched.
